title: Maze Chase and Goose Hunt
description: Complete original maze chase with buffered grid turns, paired tunnels, connected pellets, four ghost roles, visible central house and return/reform lifecycle, power pickups, bounded levels and 1P/2P cooperative play. Permanent player-hunts mode makes a goose chase and capture fleeing ghosts without contact death. Original complete directional player and ghost animation sets are bundled.

license.notes: Original project code, layout and deterministic pixel artwork. No commercial Pac-Man ROM, source code, maze map or sprite sheet was copied. The genre inspiration does not grant rights to any underlying game trademark.

animations.coordinates: 14×14 center anchor; directional player/ghost clips; center-relative hitboxes and hurtboxes

quality.notes: Complete behavior and isolated runtime evidence included; admission requires content-hash-bound review.
